record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, L2-normalize tied item embedding lookups for sequence inputs, positive/negative targets and inference candidates, with epsilon=1e-8 and padding exactly zero. Retain the sqrt(H) input multiplier, positional embeddings and dot-product scoring. Normalization previously improved validation under BPR; test whether it also benefits the current pointwise logistic objective by limiting item-norm variation. Preserve topology, history policy, loss and optimizer, and mirror normalization in the generated predictor.

category_rationales.rationale: Test L2-normalized tied item embeddings under the current pointwise logistic objective across all four datasets. Normalize sequence, target and candidate lookups with epsilon 1e-8 and exactly zero padding. Preserve input scaling, positions, causal convolutions, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports the updated model class, so inference uses identical normalization with unchanged checkpoint shapes and one model per category.
